@legend.media.music core.legend
    namespace=media.music
    version=0.1.0
    imports=core
    imports=kids.common
    doc="Music: the song library (public-domain melodies in ABC notation) and the player state"

@media.music.session core.type
    extends=core.state
    doc="The player. The world state holds instrument, tempo, volume, key, current (note, chord, scale, song or melody), score (ABC), playing, loop, the recorded melody and the keyboard highlight."
    example="Play middle C."

@media.music.song core.type
    extends=core.state
    doc="A public-domain melody in ABC notation with its composer, key and tempo."
    example="Play Twinkle Twinkle."

@media.music.song.title core.key
    value=string
    ask="What is the song called?"

@media.music.song.aka core.key
    value=string
    card=many
    ask="What else is the song called?"

@media.music.song.composer core.key
    value=string
    ask="Who wrote the song?"

@media.music.song.key core.key
    value=string
    ask="Which key is the song in?"

@media.music.song.tempo core.key
    value=integer
    ask="How fast is the song, in beats per minute?"

@media.music.song.meter core.key
    value=string
    ask="Which time signature does the song have?"

@media.music.song.year core.key
    value=integer
    ask="In which year was the song written or first published?"

@media.music.song.blurb core.key
    value=string
    ask="What is the song like?"

@media.music.song.abc core.key
    value=string
    ask="What is the song in ABC notation?"
